notes.station_ids: IDs from source map.json; use as stable keys only as long as source identifiers remain unchanged
notes.edge_semantics: Only provided game-graph adjacency; NOT real transport routes
notes.non_tram: Metro, train and unspecified nodes included with no game edges because source provides no edges for them
notes.excluded: Ownership, points, colors, timestamps, capture history, event states and live values are intentionally not included
notes.geometry: Optional polylines for rendering. Each point is [latitude, longitude].
